title: Read State Is Per Row, Not Global
description: Opening one notification in the inbox should mark exactly that one as read — every other unread notification sitting in the same inbox needs to stay untouched, dot and all.
successCondition: Generate at least 3 notifications for one customer (e.g. book 3 shipments, waiting past the queue delay for all). POST /api/notifications/:id/read for just ONE of the three. Querying the notifications table via `npm run db:psql` for all 3 ids confirms exactly the targeted one has read = true, and the other 2 still have read = false. GET /api/notifications's unreadCount afterward equals exactly (original unread count minus 1), not zero and not unchanged.
hints: markRead() (apps/api/src/modules/notifications/service.ts) updates by the notification's own id, a single-row prisma.notification.update — there's no updateMany or userId-wide side effect in that code path.
Compute unreadCount before and after the single markRead call so you're confirming an exact delta of 1, not just "some notifications are still unread".
